literal: send out · army · not yet · win

meaning.en: The expedition has not yet won, yet fails or is cut short; a setback or death before success.
meaning.zh: 出兵尚未取得胜利就遭遇挫折，多指事业未成而人先亡。

examples.zh: 这位将军出师未捷，令人惋惜。
examples.en: It is a pity the general fell before victory.

examples.zh: 公司刚起步便出师未捷，创始人没有放弃。
examples.en: The firm failed at the outset, but the founder did not give up.

story.en: On Zhuge Liang: 'The army set out before victory, and he himself died, leaving heroes forever weeping' (出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟).
story.zh: 杜甫《蜀相》：“出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟。”

usage.en: Often quoted with 'the hero dies first'; used for failure early in a venture.
usage.zh: 常接“身先死”，用于事业起步便受挫。

natural: moved by the times, saddened at heart

meaning.en: To be moved to sorrow by the state of the times or the passing seasons.
meaning.zh: 有感于时局或时序变迁而心中悲伤。

equivalents: be saddened by the state of things

examples.zh: 读到旧时的战乱，他感时伤怀，久久不语。
examples.en: Reading of the old wars, he was saddened by the times and sat silent.

examples.zh: 暮春时节，她不免感时伤怀。
examples.en: In late spring she cannot help feeling melancholy at time's passing.

usage.en: Literary, often in poetry reviews. Related to 感时花溅泪.
usage.zh: 书面语，常用于诗评；可联想杜甫“感时花溅泪”。

natural: wield the brush and splash ink

meaning.en: To write or paint with bold, flowing strokes.
meaning.zh: 挥动毛笔，大笔蘸墨，形容尽情书写或绘画。

examples.zh: 老先生兴致一来，当场挥毫泼墨。
examples.en: In high spirits the old master took up the brush on the spot.

examples.zh: 书法家在人群面前挥毫泼墨，赢得掌声。
examples.en: The calligrapher wielded the brush before the crowd and won applause.

usage.en: Positive; for calligraphy and painting, sometimes jokingly for writing.
usage.zh: 含褒义，用于书画，有时也戏指写作。

meaning.en: A travelling doctor of doubtful skill, a quack.
meaning.zh: 走江湖的游方医生，多指医术不高、骗人钱财的人。

examples.zh: 别信那个江湖郎中，他开的药没什么用。
examples.en: Don't trust that quack; his medicine is useless.

examples.zh: 他自称神医，其实是个江湖郎中。
examples.en: He calls himself a miracle doctor but is just a quack.

usage.en: Derogatory. 郎中 is an old word for doctor, pronounced láng zhōng.
usage.zh: 贬义；郎中是旧时对医生的称呼，读 láng zhōng。

natural: the horse's head wants to go east

meaning.en: Having decided to go home (east), or to turn back; wanting to give up an operation and return.
meaning.zh: 马头朝东，表示想要回乡或撤退，原指无心作战、想回家。

examples.zh: 连日阴雨，将士们都马首欲东。
examples.en: After days of rain, the soldiers all wanted to turn for home.

examples.zh: 项目屡遭挫折，不少人已马首欲东。
examples.en: With repeated setbacks, many already want to bail out.

story.en: During a campaign, Luan Yan declared he would not obey the order to advance: 'My horse's head wants to go east' (吾马首欲东), and led his troops home.
story.zh: 《左传·襄公十四年》：“栾黡曰：‘晋国之命未是有也。余马首欲东。’乃归。”

usage.en: Don't confuse with 马首是瞻 (follow someone's lead). Used of wanting to quit or return.
usage.zh: 不要与“马首是瞻”混淆；指想放弃、想回去。

meaning.en: The high seat of government, the imperial court or central power.
meaning.zh: 指朝廷、高官的位置，即中央政权。

examples.zh: 居庙堂之高，则忧其民。
examples.en: When one sits in the halls of power, one worries for the people.

examples.zh: 他身处庙堂之高，仍不忘民间疾苦。
examples.en: Though high in office, he did not forget the people's hardships.

story.en: 'Holding a high place in the court, one worries about the people; far away in the lakes and rivers, one worries about the ruler' (居庙堂之高则忧其民，处江湖之远则忧其君).
story.zh: 范仲淹《岳阳楼记》：“居庙堂之高则忧其民，处江湖之远则忧其君。”

usage.en: Usually seen in the pair with 江湖之远 (far away in the rivers and lakes). Literary.
usage.zh: 常与“江湖之远”对举，书面语。

meaning.en: To plot to overthrow the ruling dynasty and seize the throne.
meaning.zh: 图谋推翻朝廷，夺取皇位。

examples.zh: 这位权臣谋朝篡位，最终事败被杀。
examples.en: The powerful minister plotted to seize the throne and was killed when it failed.

examples.zh: 他被指控谋朝篡位，满门入狱。
examples.en: He was accused of plotting a coup and his whole family was jailed.

usage.en: Always derogatory; mostly historical. 朝 reads cháo here.
usage.zh: 贬义，多用于历史；朝读 cháo。

meaning.en: Like the fierce guardian figure in a temple, with a stern and angry look; also describes someone whose anger shows on their face.
meaning.zh: 像寺庙里的金刚力士那样怒目圆睁，形容面目凶狠或威严。

examples.zh: 他脸色铁青，如怒目金刚一般瞪着我们。
examples.en: His face dark, he glared at us like a temple guardian.

examples.zh: 别看他平时和气，发起火来像怒目金刚。
examples.en: He seems gentle, but when angry he glowers like a temple guardian.

usage.en: Often in the pair 怒目金刚 / 低眉菩萨 (stern vs gentle). Can describe stern strength.
usage.zh: 常与“低眉菩萨”对举；也可指刚猛有威势。

meaning.en: To comb through materials patiently, sorting out what matters and discarding the rest.
meaning.zh: 仔细梳理、剔除、选取材料，形容整理资料、考订文献时认真细致。

examples.zh: 他爬梳剔抉多年，终于整理出一部完整的史料。
examples.en: After years of sifting he assembled a complete set of historical sources.

examples.zh: 学者要在浩如烟海的文献中爬梳剔抉。
examples.en: Scholars must sift through a vast ocean of documents.

story.en: In 'Jin Xue Jie': 'Gather and sift, pick and choose, scrape and polish' (爬罗剔抉，刮垢磨光), praising officials who select talent.
story.zh: 韩愈《进学解》：“爬罗剔抉，刮垢磨光。”

usage.en: Used for scholarship, editing or archives. Originally 爬罗剔抉 in Han Yu, which is a close variant.
usage.zh: 用于治学、校勘、整理文献；韩愈原作“爬罗剔抉”，意思相近。

natural: love of the mulberry and catalpa

meaning.en: Affection for one's hometown; 桑梓 (mulberry and catalpa trees planted near houses) stands for home.
meaning.zh: 对故乡的深厚感情；桑梓是古人家宅旁种的树，借指故乡。

examples.zh: 这位企业家桑梓之情深厚，多次回乡捐资办学。
examples.en: The entrepreneur, deeply attached to his hometown, repeatedly donated to schools there.

examples.zh: 海外游子的桑梓之情，浓得化不开。
examples.en: The overseas wanderer's love of home is thick and unbroken.

usage.en: Used in speeches and news about overseas Chinese or returning natives.
usage.zh: 多见于致辞和对海外游子、返乡人士的报道。

meaning.en: To treasure something and hold it dear as if it were rare and precious.
meaning.zh: 把东西当作珍贵的宝物一样看待，形容十分珍惜。

examples.zh: 她把外婆留下的怀表视若珍宝。
examples.en: She treasures the pocket watch her grandmother left her.

examples.zh: 孩子对这本旧画册视若珍宝，不许别人碰。
examples.en: The child prizes this old picture book and lets no one touch it.

usage.en: Common in writing; the object usually comes before the phrase. Opposite of 视如草芥.
usage.zh: 书面常见，宾语多前置；反义为“视如草芥”。

meaning.en: Teaching and learning carry on without interruption, even in hard times.
meaning.zh: 琴声与诵读之声不断，指教学活动即使在艰难环境中也不中断。

examples.zh: 战火纷飞，西南联大仍然弦歌不辍。
examples.en: Amid the war, the Southwest Associated University kept teaching.

examples.zh: 山区学校条件简陋，却弦歌不辍。
examples.en: The mountain school is plain, yet classes never stop.

usage.en: Praising education and culture that survive difficulty. 辍 reads chuò.
usage.zh: 赞扬在艰难中坚持办学求学；辍读 chuò。

meaning.en: To do good for one's native place.
meaning.zh: 为家乡人民谋福利。

equivalents: give back to one's native place

examples.zh: 他功成名就后回乡创业，造福桑梓。
examples.en: After making his name, he returned to start a business and benefit his hometown.

examples.zh: 乡贤捐资修路，造福桑梓。
examples.en: A local worthy donated money to build a road for his hometown.

usage.en: Formal; used in news and speeches. 梓 reads zǐ (3rd tone).
usage.zh: 正式用语，见于新闻和致辞；梓读 zǐ。

natural: with poems and books in the belly

meaning.en: A person full of learning shows an elegant bearing: 'poetry and books in the belly, grace shows in the air'.
meaning.zh: 腹中装满诗书，指学识渊博；常与“气自华”连用，说明读书使人气质高雅。

examples.zh: 她腹有诗书，举手投足间自带一份从容。
examples.en: With her wide reading, her every gesture carries a quiet ease.

examples.zh: 都说腹有诗书气自华，读书的人气质不一样。
examples.en: They say learning gives a person grace; readers have a different air.

story.en: 'Coarse cloth and rough robes, yet with poems and books in the belly, grace comes of itself' (腹有诗书气自华).
story.zh: 苏轼《和董传留别》：“粗缯大布裹生涯，腹有诗书气自华。”

usage.en: Typically quoted in full as 腹有诗书气自华. Positive, about the cultivated.
usage.zh: 常整句引用“腹有诗书气自华”，称赞有学养的人。

meaning.en: The pleasure quarters; brothels in old times.
meaning.zh: 旧指妓院聚集的地方，即风月场所。

examples.zh: 这位公子终日出入烟花柳巷，家产败光。
examples.en: The young gentleman spent his days in the pleasure quarter and squandered his fortune.

examples.zh: 小说描写了旧上海的烟花柳巷。
examples.en: The novel portrays the pleasure quarters of old Shanghai.

usage.en: Usually historical or literary; derogatory or at least discreet. 巷 reads xiàng.
usage.zh: 多用于历史或文学语境，带贬义或委婉；巷读 xiàng。

meaning.en: Messages carried across great distance; the old image of letters passing between faraway people.
meaning.zh: 借大雁传递书信，指远方来信，传递音讯。

examples.zh: 两人分隔两地，只能鸿雁传书。
examples.en: Living far apart, the two could only write letters.

examples.zh: 鸿雁传书的年代，一封信要走一个月。
examples.en: In the days of wild-goose letters, a letter took a month to arrive.

story.en: Su Wu was held among the Xiongnu; his men told the Khan that the emperor had shot a goose bearing a message tied to its foot, revealing that Su Wu was alive (雁足系帛书).
story.zh: 《汉书·苏武传》：天子射上林中，得雁，足有系帛书。

usage.en: Poetic for correspondence. Now mostly used jokingly of letters, email or messages.
usage.zh: 诗意地指书信往来，现在多带玩笑色彩，也指电邮和消息。

natural: tread snow to seek plum blossoms

meaning.en: To walk through the snow looking for plum blossoms; an elegant pastime of cultivated people.
meaning.zh: 冒雪赏梅，指文人雅士的闲情逸致。

examples.zh: 雪后初晴，几位好友相约踏雪寻梅。
examples.en: When the snow cleared, friends arranged a walk to seek plum blossoms.

examples.zh: 他的画里常有踏雪寻梅的高士。
examples.en: His paintings often show scholars walking in the snow to find plum blossoms.

usage.en: Literary and elegant; popular as a painting motif.
usage.zh: 典雅，常作绘画题材。

meaning.en: To turn around suddenly and find what one has long sought; also, to look back unexpectedly on one's past.
meaning.zh: 猛然回头，发现自己苦苦寻找的东西就在眼前；也指忽然回望往事。

equivalents: suddenly look back and find it

examples.zh: 蓦然回首，那人却在灯火阑珊处。
examples.en: Turning suddenly, there she was where the lights were dim.

examples.zh: 蓦然回首，二十年已经过去了。
examples.en: Looking back suddenly, twenty years had already gone.

story.en: 'Searching for her in the crowd a thousand times, I turn suddenly, and she is there, where the lamplight is dim' (众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处).
story.zh: 辛弃疾《青玉案·元夕》：“众里寻他千百度。蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处。”

usage.en: Quoted in 'Qing Yu An'; used for sudden insight or realisation.
usage.zh: 多引辛弃疾词句，形容突然的领悟或发现。

meaning.en: When the root is firm, the branches flourish; a strong foundation brings prosperity.
meaning.zh: 树根稳固，枝叶才茂盛，比喻基础牢固，事业才能兴旺。

examples.zh: 国家要本固枝荣，必须重视教育和人才。
examples.en: For a country to prosper on firm roots, it must value education and talent.

examples.zh: 家业传承，本固枝荣，靠的是代代积德。
examples.en: A family business lasts when roots are firm, built on generations of good deeds.

usage.en: Often used for family, nation or company; the focus is on the foundation (本).
usage.zh: 常用于国家、家族、企业，强调根基（本）。

meaning.en: To be content to lag behind and make no effort to excel.
meaning.zh: 甘心处于落后的地位，不求上进。

examples.zh: 我们不能甘居下游，要奋起直追。
examples.en: We cannot settle for lagging behind; we must catch up.

examples.zh: 他从不甘居下游，每次考试都争前列。
examples.en: He never settles for the bottom, always aiming for the top in exams.

usage.en: Mostly negated: 不甘居下游 (unwilling to lag behind); used in exhortations.
usage.zh: 多用否定式“不甘居下游”，用于鼓励。

meaning.en: To bring honour to one's forebears and leave a rich legacy to one's descendants.
meaning.zh: 光大前人的事业，造福后代子孙。

equivalents: honour the ancestors and bless the descendants

examples.zh: 他创办学校，光前裕后，被乡里称颂。
examples.en: He founded a school, honouring his ancestors and benefiting later generations, and the locals praised him.

examples.zh: 先辈开基立业，后人当光前裕后。
examples.en: Our forebears built the business; their descendants must carry it on and enrich it.

usage.en: Used in congratulations and family history writing.
usage.zh: 常用于贺词和家史记述。

meaning.en: To build many good relationships and do good works widely, so as to be well-regarded and enjoy good fortune.
meaning.zh: 广泛与人结下好的缘分，多做善事，多交朋友。

examples.zh: 做生意要广结善缘，朋友多了路才宽。
examples.en: In business you should build goodwill widely; more friends means more paths.

examples.zh: 他一生广结善缘，晚年得到许多帮助。
examples.en: All his life he made good connections and received much help in old age.

usage.en: Buddhist flavour; today also used for networking in a warm sense.
usage.zh: 带佛教色彩，今也指广交朋友、人缘好。

meaning.en: To have many friends and acquaintances in all walks of life.
meaning.zh: 朋友和熟人很多，社交面很广。

examples.zh: 他交游广阔，各行各业都有朋友。
examples.en: He is well connected, with friends in every trade.

examples.zh: 一个记者交游广阔，消息自然灵通。
examples.en: A reporter with a wide circle of contacts is naturally well informed.

usage.en: Neutral to positive; can hint at being a social butterfly.
usage.zh: 中性偏褒，有时暗含爱交际。
